Asset: one native 1254 x 1254 joint seam repair crop for a continuous hand-painted Q Daoist game map.

Image 1 is the only authoritative full-map layout reference. Image 2 is the material/style reference only, not a coordinate crop. Image 3 is the primary approved rounded Q Daoist painting style only; copy no UI, text, characters, night scene or decorative frame. Image 4 is the sole EDIT TARGET: an exact 1254-square native crop, already positioned and scaled correctly.

Repair the visible vertical splice at x=627 in image 4. This is one continuous stone walkway beside the same fish display, not two scenes. In the upper/central pale grey paving, diagonal slab joints currently stop or jump at that vertical line, especially around x=627,y=320..600. Reconstruct the stone polygons jointly on BOTH sides of x=627, mainly within x=350..900,y=180..700, so each existing diagonal joint continues smoothly across the old splice with consistent slope, width, soft rounded bevel, perspective and slab size. Resolve the abruptly cut slab edge around y=490..535 into one coherent stone junction. Match the established calm pale grey/blue-grey stone color and subtle grain; eliminate the straight vertical color boundary through actual coherent painted stone, not blur or feathering. Do not create a new grid, change overall paving direction, or add extra cracks.

LOCKED INVARIANTS: preserve the outermost 180 pixels along ALL FOUR sides of image 4 exactly in geometry, colors and texture. Preserve the entire existing fish display, every visible fish head/body/fin, all ice, the long diagonal golden wood rim, the crossing thin internal wood divider, all shadows, the upper-right post and cropped furniture. Do not repaint or move the fish display to solve a stone seam. Keep the current camera, close-up scale, crop, object positions and lighting. Only the interior stone joints and their immediately adjacent stone faces may change. No enlargement, zoom, recentering or scene reconstruction.

Return only the repaired 1254 x 1254 image with the identical frame. Bright clean daylight, softly rounded painterly surfaces, low-contrast stone joints. Add no people, fish, furniture, objects, trees, red pavement, text, UI, grid, labels, watermark, border, blur or feathered seam.
